absent: Locking discipline and concurrency rules for association policy migration mapping offload and regulator notification handling.
Entry point addresses system call numbers and netlink dispatch behaviour beyond descriptor and constant definitions.
State machines for acquire expire report migration mapping and regulator sequencing including ordering and error recovery.
Implementation algorithms for replay protection lifetime enforcement selector matching cryptographic processing and threshold decisions.
Memory ownership allocation lifetime alignment padding and error return conventions for the described descriptors.

findings.text: The transform user interface exposes netlink oriented management vocabulary for associations and policies, with an attribute enumeration plus association and policy descriptors plus lifetime and replay helpers plus acquire expire and report exchanges plus migration mapping and offload helpers for keying agents.

The main attribute enumeration begins at an unspecified zero member and assigns successive integers to later members, ending at an internal maximum sentinel, while the public maximum equals one less than that sentinel and the output mark name reuses the set mark value for compatibility.

The mark holder named xfrm_mark carries a value component called v together with a mask component called m, each stored as an unsigned thirty two bit quantity, expressing masked packet marking semantics.

Database attribute enumerations for associations and policies each start at an unspecified member and close with an internal sentinel, with public maxima defined as one below the sentinel, covering counters and hash details for associations and directional counts plus hash details plus threshold controls for policies.

Association hash sizing snapshot reports current bucket usage in sadhcnt alongside allowed maximum in sadhmcnt, while policy hash sizing uses spdhcnt alongside spdhmcnt and threshold tuning uses local prefix bits in lbits alongside remote prefix bits in rbits.

Policy database counters snapshot holds six unsigned thirty two bit tallies distinguishing input output and forward paths for plain entries versus socket bound entries, using incnt plus outcnt plus fwdcnt plus inscnt plus outscnt plus fwdscnt.

Association descriptor opens with traffic selection in sel then peer identity in id then local source address in saddr then configured lifetime in lft then observed lifetime in curlft then traffic statistics in stats, establishing selector identity and lifetime context before numeric control fields.

Trailing control portion of the association descriptor carries ordering number in seq then binding identifier in reqid then address family in family then encapsulation mode in mode then replay window size in replay_window then option octet in flags.

Flag XFRM_STATE_NOECN takes value one and concerns ECN, while flag XFRM_STATE_DECAP_DSCP takes value two and concerns DSCP, while flag XFRM_STATE_NOPMTUDISC takes value four and concerns MTU discovery, while flag XFRM_STATE_WILDRECV takes value eight and concerns wildcard reception.

Flag XFRM_STATE_ICMP takes value sixteen and concerns ICMP handling, while flag XFRM_STATE_AF_UNSPEC takes value thirty two and concerns unspecified family, while flag XFRM_STATE_ALIGN4 takes value sixty four and concerns alignment, while flag XFRM_STATE_ESN takes value one hundred twenty eight and concerns extended sequence.
Extended flag XFRM_SA_XFLAG_DONT_ENCAP_DSCP takes value one and avoids DSCP encapsulation, while extended flag XFRM_SA_XFLAG_OSEQ_MAY_WRAP takes value two and permits output sequence wrap.
Compact association identifier carries destination address in daddr then security parameter index in spi as big endian thirty two bit then family in family then protocol number in proto.
Asynchronous event identifier embeds compact association identifier in sa_id then source address in saddr then option word in flags then binding identifier in reqid.
SPI allocation request embeds full association descriptor in info then lower bound in min then upper bound in max, expressing desired SPI range for allocation.

Policy descriptor opens with selector in sel then configured lifetime in lft then observed lifetime in curlft then precedence in priority then handle in index then direction in dir then decision in action then options in flags then sharing behaviour in share.
Policy verdict XFRM_POLICY_ALLOW takes value zero for allow, while verdict XFRM_POLICY_BLOCK takes value one for block.

Policy option XFRM_POLICY_LOCALOK takes value one for local override, while option XFRM_POLICY_ICMP takes value two for ICMP expansion, while option XFRM_POLICY_CPU_ACQUIRE takes value four for CPU triggered acquisition.

Policy identifier carries selector in sel then handle in index then direction in dir, while flush request carries only protocol number in proto, while report request carries protocol in proto together with selector in sel.

Acquire exchange carries peer identity in id then source address in saddr then selector in sel then triggering policy in policy then authentication mask in aalgos then encryption mask in ealgos then compression mask in calgos then ordering number in seq.

Association expiry notice embeds association descriptor in state together with hardness indicator in hard, while policy expiry notice embeds policy descriptor in pol together with hardness indicator in hard.
Key manager address descriptor carries local address in local then remote address in remote then reserved word in reserved then family in family.

Migration request carries old destination in old_daddr then old source in old_saddr then new destination in new_daddr then new source in new_saddr then protocol in proto then mode in mode then reserved in reserved then binding in reqid then old family in old_family then new family in new_family.

Migration state entry carries association identifier in id then new destination in new_daddr then new source in new_saddr then prior mark in old_mark then replacement selector in new_sel then replacement binding in new_reqid then option word in flags then replacement family in new_family then padding in reserved.

Migration option XFRM_MIGRATE_STATE_CLEAR_OFFLOAD takes value one and drops offload inheritance, while option XFRM_MIGRATE_STATE_UPDATE_H2H_SEL takes value two and refreshes host to host selection, while combined mask XFRM_MIGRATE_STATE_KNOWN_FLAGS joins both bits.

Address mapping entry carries association identifier in id then binding in reqid then prior source in old_saddr then replacement source in new_saddr then prior port in old_sport as big endian sixteen bit then replacement port in new_sport as big endian sixteen bit.
Address filter carries source base in saddr then destination base in daddr then family in family then source prefix length in splen then destination prefix length in dplen.
Offload descriptor carries interface index in ifindex as signed integer then option octet in flags.

Offload option XFRM_OFFLOAD_IPV6 takes value one for IPv6 handling, while option XFRM_OFFLOAD_INBOUND takes value two for inbound direction, while option XFRM_OFFLOAD_PACKET takes value four for packet mode.
Default policy container holds three unsigned eight bit verdicts distinguishing inbound handling in field in versus forward handling in field fwd versus outbound handling in field out.
Default verdict XFRM_USERPOLICY_UNSPEC takes value zero for unspecified, while verdict XFRM_USERPOLICY_BLOCK takes value one for deny, while verdict XFRM_USERPOLICY_ACCEPT takes value two for permit.

Compatibility bit XFRMGRP_ACQUIRE takes value one while bit XFRMGRP_EXPIRE takes value two while bit XFRMGRP_SA takes value four while bit XFRMGRP_POLICY takes value eight while bit XFRMGRP_REPORT takes value 0x20.

Netlink multicast enumeration assigns successive integers starting at NONE zero through ACQUIRE then EXPIRE then SA then POLICY then AEVENTS then REPORT then MIGRATE then MAPPING, identifying subscription groups for keying events.
Each multicast enumerator is mirrored by a preprocessor alias of identical spelling, and the public maximum equals one less than an internal maximum sentinel.

Regulator user interface exposes a bitmask event vocabulary for power faults warnings and sequencing together with a generic netlink family that delivers kernel to user notifications carrying regulator name and event word.

Regulator bit REGULATOR_EVENT_UNDER_VOLTAGE takes value 0x01 while bit REGULATOR_EVENT_OVER_CURRENT takes value 0x02 while bit REGULATOR_EVENT_REGULATION_OUT takes value 0x04 while bit REGULATOR_EVENT_FAIL takes value 0x08.

Regulator bit REGULATOR_EVENT_OVER_TEMP takes value 0x10 while bit REGULATOR_EVENT_FORCE_DISABLE takes value 0x20 while bit REGULATOR_EVENT_VOLTAGE_CHANGE takes value 0x40 while bit REGULATOR_EVENT_DISABLE takes value 0x80.

Regulator bit REGULATOR_EVENT_PRE_VOLTAGE_CHANGE takes value 0x100 while bit REGULATOR_EVENT_ABORT_VOLTAGE_CHANGE takes value 0x200 while bit REGULATOR_EVENT_PRE_DISABLE takes value 0x400 while bit REGULATOR_EVENT_ABORT_DISABLE takes value 0x800.

Regulator bit REGULATOR_EVENT_ENABLE takes value 0x1000 while bit REGULATOR_EVENT_UNDER_VOLTAGE_WARN takes value 0x2000 while bit REGULATOR_EVENT_OVER_CURRENT_WARN takes value 0x4000 while bit REGULATOR_EVENT_OVER_VOLTAGE_WARN takes value 0x8000.
Regulator bit REGULATOR_EVENT_OVER_TEMP_WARN takes value 0x10000 while mask REGULATOR_EVENT_WARN_MASK takes value 0x1E000 and aggregates the four warning bits.
Generic netlink event container carries a thirty two octet regulator name in reg_name together with a sixty four bit event word in event.

Generic netlink attribute enumeration holds an unspecified member plus an event member closed by an internal maximum, with public maximum one below the sentinel, while command enumeration similarly holds unspecified plus event with its own sentinel derived maximum.
Regulator family name takes value reg_event while version takes value 0x01 while multicast group takes value reg_mc_group.
Display identification container holds one hundred twenty eight unsigned bytes in a dummy array, representing a fixed size identification block.
User visible headers employ include guards that record a unique macro on first inclusion to suppress repeated processing.

Fixed width name and identification arrays plus mixed endian integer fields require callers to enforce termination and bounds and to convert big endian indices and ports, since truncation or byte order mistakes would corrupt association policy or notification interpretation.
